name: opencode-veris-sim
description: Test an application against Veris - stateful twins of the external services it calls. Three commands: setup (wire a repo once), build <issue|prompt> (measure the vendor before designing, prove the change through veris-proxy), fix <issue|prompt> (reproduce the failure first, prove it closed). Plus the veris MCP server.
author: Veris (https://veris.ai)
